responsibility: Provides rustc_transmute’s shared type-layout representation and conversion pipeline: `mod.rs` defines the common byte/definition/reference/uninhabited abstractions, reexports the layout forms, and exposes rustc-specific adapters for extracting layouts and reference metadata from compiler types; `tree.rs` builds and prunes a tree-structured layout from rustc layouts while tracking sequencing, alternation, references, definitions, bytes, and inhabitedness; `tree/tests.rs` verifies the pruning semantics for definition nodes and their effects on unit and uninhabited layouts; `nfa.rs` lowers pruned layout trees into a nondeterministic automaton over byte offsets and validity/reference edges; and `dfa.rs` determinizes that automaton into split byte/reference transition tables so later transmutability checking can follow unique transitions through the layout.
